title: ### I. SURVEY OF CRIME ### A. IPC Crime 9,84,773 cognizable crimes under the IPC were reported during 1972 in India showing an increase of 3.4% over 1971. This figure also includes crimes committed by juveniles. The incidence of crime during the last decade indicates an erratic trend from year to year but during this period—there had been an overall increase of 46% while the increase in population during the same period was 24%.
